statement: Every company registered in Singapore must file an annual return with ACRA each year while it remains live, dormant or not; a non-listed company files within 7 months after its financial year end (8 months where it has a share capital and keeps an overseas branch register), and a listed company within 5 months (6 with a share capital and an overseas branch register).
caveat: Late filing draws penalties of up to $600 per return and ACRA enforcement; the financial year end cannot be changed after the filing deadline has passed. The underlying provision is Companies Act 1967 section 197; the annual return is separate from the IRAS tax return.
